title: VooPoo Argus P2 Pod Vape Kit
description: The Voopoo Argus P2 Pod Kit combines sleek design with exceptional versatility and functionality. This device retains the mechanical and futuristic aesthetics of its predecessor, the Argus P1, while introducing enhanced interactive features and smart technology. With its robust 1100mAh built-in battery, and 30W max power output, the Argus P2 ensures extended vaping sessions and supports USB-C fast charging for extra convenience. The device displays all essential data on an OLED screen , including battery life, wattage, and coil resistance, alongside five RGB LED light to quickly assess your battery level. The chipset offers multiple Vaping Modes: Shift Mode, which allows for variable wattage adjustments, and three Power Modes: • SPT mode: Full-bodied flavour • NOR mode: Optimum vaping experience • ECO mode: Reduced power and e-liquid consumption The Argus P2 kit includes an ARGUS Top Fill Cartridge 0.7ohm pod as well as a 0.4ohm ARGUS Top Fill Cartridge, enhancing your vaping experience with their long lifespan, and improved anti-leakage design. Both offer a 2mL e-liquid capacity cartridge, ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) and RDL (restricted direct-to-lung) vaping. The P2’s compact, lightweight ‘matchbox’-style form factor is not just stylish but also practical, with a hidden lanyard ring for easy portability and a stunning metallic finish that’s available in multiple colours. The device's powerful performance, durability, and innovative features like the adjustable airflow and two power modes make the Argus P2 a standout choice for both new and experienced vapers. Please note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
